name: Moar
locations: Banani 11, Dhanmondi 27, and Gulshan-Tejgaon Link Road.
priceRange: Starter Pro membership BDT 12,000; annual membership BDT 10,000; Executive from BDT 800. Meeting rooms BDT 250–1,000 per hour by room size.
hours: 8:00–22:00, six days a week; closed Fridays and government holidays.
applicationPath: Book or enquire through the Moar site.
notes: The most transparent pricing of the spaces here, and the only one with three Dhaka locations. Third-party listings quote different rates — trust the site.

name: Impact Hub Dhaka
locations: Mirpur (Grameen Telecom Bhaban, Zoo Road) and Banani (Momen Bari Heights, Road 12).
applicationPath: Book a space or enquire through the Impact Hub Dhaka site.
notes: Part of the global Impact Hub network, so the draw is the programmes, events and investor and partner network as much as the desk. Prices come on enquiry.

name: Ecommerce BD Business Center
locations: Two Dhaka locations; addresses not stated on the coworking page.
priceRange: Shared hot desk from BDT 11,000/month; dedicated executive desk from BDT 20,000/month; manager chamber from BDT 45,000; CEO/director room from BDT 55,000; meeting room BDT 15,000 per meeting.
hours: 24-hour access stated for hot desk plans.
applicationPath: Enquire through the Ecommerce BD site.
notes: Serviced-office pricing with business support attached, rather than a community-first coworking floor. The page's own FAQ quotes a different dedicated-desk rate, so confirm before signing.

name: hubdhaka
priceRange: Not publicly stated on the homepage; a plans page is linked.
applicationPath: View plans and join through the hubdhaka site.
notes: Aimed at freelancers and solo founders working alone at home. Mirpur location makes it one of the cheaper commutes if you live north.
